title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Azure, Active Directory & Hybrid Infrastructure (m/f/d)
description: Salary: €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Remote within Germany or Switzerland (proximity to our Bexbach site is a plus) You want full ownership of a group's Azure and hybrid environment: not just tickets, but the architecture, the governance, and the direction it takes? Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology. Why join us? 🎯 Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development. 🌍 Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations. 🤝 International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites. 🚀 Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure. 📚 Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company. About us – in brief Headquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%. Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide. Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure. Your Role – What You'll Own You will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform. Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation. Your Responsibilities Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites. Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication. Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need. Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites. Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop. Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs. Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues. Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities. Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned. What You Bring We are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations. Must-have – Essential Requirements The following skills and experience are essential for this position: Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage. Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure. Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management. Infrastructure Modernization A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems. Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations. Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments. Identity & Access Management Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments. Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication. Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls. Endpoint Management Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment. Resilience, Security & Monitoring Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor. Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation. Communication & Collaboration Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations. Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders. Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage. Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations. Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered. Nice-to-have – Additional Experience The following skills are beneficial but not essential: Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects. Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods. Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management. Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers. Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Identity or Microsoft Sentinel. Experience supporting application development teams, e.g. Azure App Service, Azure DevOps or GitHub. Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Bicep or Terraform. Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing or GxP. Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, MD-102 or SC-300. Your First 12 Months Your initial focus will be on delivering measurable improvements across our global infrastructure: Assess and develop a roadmap for standardizing our Azure and hybrid infrastructure. Review and rationalize our existing server environments, replacing unsupported systems and reducing technical debt. Review our Active Directory and hybrid identity architecture and initiate consolidation where required. Strengthen centralized endpoint management through Microsoft Intune. Establish consistent Azure governance, resource standards and cost transparency. Improve infrastructure security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery. Evaluate application delivery solutions and reduce unnecessary reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop. What We Offer Remote-first working: Work remotely within Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site. Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary of €60,000–80,000, depending on experience. Additional payments: Christmas and vacation bonuses. Company pension scheme: Support for your long-term financial security. Career development: Individual training and development opportunities in an internationally operating company. Employee benefits: Free water and coffee, as well as company products at employee prices. Team culture: Regular team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the group. 📍 Location: Remote within Germany or Switzerland (Bexbach proximity is a plus) 📅 Start date: As soon as possible ⏳ Employment type: Permanent, full-time Ready to Shape Our Global IT Infrastructure? We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership, make things better and deliver real technical improvements. Send us your application – no perfectly polished cover letter required. We are interested in your experience, your technical expertise and what you can bring to our team. We look forward to hearing from you! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Du führst und entwickelst das SEO-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch weiter, förderst individuelle Stärken und schaffst eine Kultur aus Eigenverantwortung, Lernen und messbaren Erfolgen. title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description: At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. The phone call, the contact form, the support ticket: all of it is being replaced by messaging and AI. We're building the platform that runs underneath. Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day . We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams. We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin. We're hiring our first Data Engineer to own Superchat's data platform end to end, from raw product and business data to the gold tables the whole company reports on. Our engineers have already built the foundations, including a warehouse, pipelines, dbt and reverse ETL. Now we need someone to make the platform trustworthy at scale, with testing, monitoring, clear modelling layers and customer history over time. You'll set the standards for how data is modelled and documented, and work with a Business Analyst to build the gold tables that Finance, Sales, Marketing and Product rely on. Who We Want An experienced Data Engineer. You bring 3+ years of building and running data pipelines in production, ideally at a SaaS company. You've owned a data platform, or a large part of one, and you're comfortable making the architecture calls yourself. Strong in SQL and dbt. You write and review complex SQL with ease. You've built dbt projects with layered models, tests, documentation. At home in the Cloud. You have worked with Data Warehouses in the Cloud, ideally AWS Redshift. BigQuery or Snowflake is also fine. Reliability-minded. You think in tests, freshness checks, idempotent loads and backfills. You want to know the data is wrong before a stakeholder tells you. Curious about the business. You want to know what MRR, churn or an "active workspace" really mean, and you model data so those definitions hold everywhere they're used. Experience with subscription billing or product usage data is a plus. Who We Don’t Want Pure dashboard builder. You'd rather spend your days building dashboards and answering ad-hoc questions. That's our Business Analyst's job; yours is to build what they work from. Pure pipeline plumber. You move data from A to B but don't care what it means. Gold tables are only as good as the business understanding behind them. Over-engineer. You want Kafka, Spark and a lakehouse for data that fits comfortably in Redshift. We need pragmatic solutions that fit a 100-person company and can grow with it. Remote-only operator. You prefer fully remote work and don't want to build relationships in person. The data platform sits between many teams, and that works best with regular time together in our Berlin office.
